data.body: **[P1] Pass the immutable checked-out SHA to the layer workflow.** The Maven job resolves this tag during checkout, while this workflow resolves it again later. If the tag moves between jobs, Maven artifacts and the public layer can come from different commits while the version and ancestry checks still pass. Capture `git rev-parse HEAD` after the release checkout, expose it as a job output, pass that SHA as `source_ref`, and verify the tag still resolves to it.
